instruction: Dynamically change playback speed according to scene complexity to maximize viewing efficiency.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot automatically analyze scene complexity and dynamically adjust playback speed in response. While VLC does support manual playback speed adjustment, it has no built-in scene analysis, content understanding, or AI-powered automatic speed adjustment capabilities. Determining 'scene complexity' would require sophisticated video content analysis that VLC does not provide.
